name: wendy-robots
description: Get started with a robot, edge device, or local simulator. Browse devices, preview cameras, edit approved projects, and deploy apps in ChatGPT. Wendy Cloud is optional for local use.

interface.longDescription: New to Wendy? Get help setting up your first robot or small computer, or try a simulator while waiting for hardware. Local use does not require a Cloud account. Browse your fleet with Wendy 3D models, inspect devices, preview cameras, open app web UIs, and control approved apps. With local permissions, create robot simulators, open their live MuJoCo scenes, edit approved project files, and build and deploy apps. Share selected device and camera context with ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Open Wendy and show my robots.
Look through my robot's camera and describe the scene.
Check which apps are running on my robot.
